user.title: SRNE inverter
user.description: Enter the address of the RS485-to-Ethernet converter (Waveshare in Modbus TCP <-> RTU mode).

data_description.password: Leave empty to avoid storing the password. You then enter it when unlocking (the 'Settings lock' entity) and it is kept in memory only. Writes from automations then require the settings to be unlocked first.

error.invalid_password: The password must contain digits only (0-65535)
